setup: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms resting at your sides, palms pressed into the floor.
Bend your knees to approximately 90 degrees and lift your feet slightly off the floor.
steps: Contract your abdominals to curl your pelvis off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause for a brief contraction at the top as your lower back lifts off the floor.
Lower your pelvis back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner without letting your lower back arch off the mat.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl your hips toward your chest; inhale as you slowly return to the starting position.
cues: Roll your pelvis toward your ribs

common_faults.fault: Swinging the legs to generate momentum rather than curling the pelvis.
common_faults.correction: Keep your knee angle fixed and focus entirely on posterior pelvic tilt and rolling the hips up.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the lumbar spine to hyperextend at the bottom of the movement.
common_faults.correction: Stop the descent before your lower back peels off the floor and maintain core engagement throughout.

name: Reverse Crunch
summary: A supine bodyweight core exercise where the pelvis is curled off the floor toward the ribs to target the abdominals.
